LanguageData.LP_AL_Experimental.label: experimental elixir
LanguageData.LP_AL_Experimental.description: Passive: each new day while awake, 1 random experimental elixir (healing, swiftness, resilience, lightness, clarity, courage) appears in your pack automatically. At the drug lab you can also make a specific elixir from 1 herbal medicine + 5 steel (30 minutes). Anyone can drink the elixirs; they spoil in 3 days. Alchemist, artificer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_AL_Savant.label: alchemical savant
LanguageData.LP_AL_Savant.description: Passive: the daily experimental elixirs become 2 bottles. Elixirs you make are all refined (healing and duration ×1.3); making vanilla drugs +30% speed. Alchemist, artificer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_AL_Restorative.label: restorative reagent
LanguageData.LP_AL_Restorative.description: Make a restorative reagent and put it in your pack: drinking it instantly cures one disease (flu, plague, parasites, food poisoning, etc.) or clears toxic buildup. Passive: poison and acid damage taken -50%, no toxic buildup in toxic fallout or toxic gas. Cooldown 1 day. Alchemist, artificer level 11.
LanguageData.LP_AL_Chemist.label: chemical mastery
LanguageData.LP_AL_Chemist.description: Ultimate passive: the daily experimental elixirs become 3 bottles, and you can pick the kind with "choose elixir". Yourself immune to poison, acid, fire and burn damage. Alchemist, artificer level 15.
LanguageData.LP_AR_ArcaneArmor.label: arcane armor
LanguageData.LP_AR_ArcaneArmor.description: Spend 4 hours standing by a workbench (within 3 cells) converting a worn torso armor (flak vest, marine armor, power armor and the like, picking the best-armored one) into arcane armor: it no longer slows movement. Switching to other armor requires converting again. Guardian: melee hits add 6 × artifice power lightning damage and taunt the target. Infiltrator: movement +10%, enemy ranged attacks have a 10% chance to miss you. Armorer, artificer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_AR_Modifications.label: armor modifications
LanguageData.LP_AR_Modifications.description: Passive: arcane armor's enchantment instantly +2 (once per piece, cap still +10). Arcane armor and helmets won't be shot to pieces and dropped (at least 1 durability left). Armorer, artificer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_AR_Upgrade.label: armor upgrade
LanguageData.LP_AR_Upgrade.description: Passive: while wearing arcane armor, all three armor values +15%. The Guardian's defensive field doubles; the Infiltrator's lightning launcher deals +50% damage, doubled again against enemies that haven't fired yet. Armorer, artificer level 11.
LanguageData.LP_AR_Perfected.label: perfected armor
LanguageData.LP_AR_Perfected.description: Ultimate passive: arcane armor is fully sealed, immune to toxic fallout, toxic gas and vacuum. Guardian: every 10 seconds magnetically pull an enemy within 6 cells to your side and taunt it. Infiltrator: enemies you hit are marked for 10 seconds, can't turn invisible, and the next hit from a teammate deals +50% damage. Armorer, artificer level 15.
LanguageData.LP_FE_Reinforce.label: reinforced construction
LanguageData.LP_FE_Reinforce.description: Passive: walls, doors, sandbags and other cover and turrets you built get +50% max health; your building repair speed ×2. Fortress Engineer, artificer level 3.
LanguageData.LP_FE_Capacitor.label: arcane capacitor
LanguageData.LP_FE_Capacitor.description: Passive: can build arcane capacitors (power tab, 20 steel + 1 component): 300 W output without fuel, turrets within 3 cells get +15% fire rate. Each engineer can support at most artificer level ÷ 3 of them. Fortress Engineer, artificer level 7.
LanguageData.LP_FE_Fortify.label: field reinforcement
LanguageData.LP_FE_Fortify.description: Select a 5×5 area within 20 cells; buildings inside take -75% damage for 12 hours, a specific counter to sappers digging through walls and breaching. Passive: colonists right next to cover you built take another -15% ranged damage. Cooldown 1 day. Fortress Engineer, artificer level 11.
LanguageData.LP_FE_Citadel.label: heart of the fortress
LanguageData.LP_FE_Citadel.description: Ultimate passive: can build a fortress core (security tab, 3×3, 1 per colony, 500 steel + 10 components + 2 advanced components): defensive buildings you built within radius 20 repair 5% per hour automatically; once per raid, "full-line upgrade" gives all turrets in range (including rune turrets) +30% damage for 1 hour. Fortress Engineer, artificer level 15.
